## Appearance

Marilla Cuthbert is a tall, thin, gaunt woman defined by sharp angles and no curves. She has a sallow, wrinkled cheek, and her dark hair, which is streaked with gray, is pulled back into a hard little knot secured with two aggressively stuck wire hairpins. She exhibits a tired appearance, and her hands are hard and work-worn.

## Personality

Marilla Cuthbert is a self-contained, sensible woman known for her rigid conscience, strict nature, and love of neatness and order. Reserved in expressing her deep affection, she is fond of tacking morals onto her remarks to children and detests child stinginess, though she refuses on principle to criticize ministers. Although she can prove inexorable and becomes sarcastic when suffering from headaches, she has mellowed over time. She is motivated to fulfill her duty of raising and training children, striving to drill them into a tranquil uniformity of disposition while ensuring she is not eclipsed by other housekeepers. Additionally, she is skilled in domestic culinary arts, celebrated locally for her famous yellow plum preserves and three-year-old homemade currant wine.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert lived at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for decades without ever having brought up a child [F4, F8]. Having never forgiven her former beau, John Blythe, after a youthful quarrel, she had enjoyed a quiet life with few troubles alongside her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) [F3, F5, F6]. This simple existence changed when she agreed to adopt an orphan boy to help with farm work, only to be shocked when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) returned home with a young girl named [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [S1, S3]. Though Marilla initially insisted the child must be sent back, she relented after learning of Anne's hard past and agreed to keep her [S3, S5, S6]. As she took on the task of raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Marilla was often tested by the girl's vivid imagination and frequent blunders, such as when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) mistakenly confessed to losing Marilla's inherited amethyst brooch [F7, S8, S14]. Despite her strict discipline, Marilla gradually admitted to herself that she was becoming fond of [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and came to love her deeply [S12, S28]. Her affection was solidified when [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) suddenly passed away and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) chose to forego her college scholarship to stay home, care for Marilla's failing eyesight, and manage [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) together [S44, S45]. Later, Marilla agreed to take in her late relative's young twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, managing Davy's mischievous behavior alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) [S53, S54, S58, S69]. When a neighbor's passing left Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) widowed, Marilla proposed that Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), which allowed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to finally pursue her college education [S73].

## Quotes

> "I’d never dream of taking a girl to bring up. I wonder at Mrs. Alexander Spencer for doing it. But there, she wouldn’t shrink from adopting a whole orphan asylum if she took it into her head."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER I. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Surprised P29](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0029)

> “There, there, Marilla, you can have your own way,” said Matthew reassuringly. “Only be as good and kind to her as you can without spoiling her. I kind of think she’s one of the sort you can do anything with if you only get her to love you.”
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VI. Marilla Makes Up Her Mind P35](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0035)

> "I suppose we could, but we decided not to. Matthew took a fancy to her. And I must say I like her myself—although I admit she has her faults. The house seems a different place already. She’s a real bright little thing."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P9](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0009)

> "when I make up my mind to do a thing it stays made up. I suppose you’d like to see Anne. I’ll call her in."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P12](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0012)

> "I’m not trying to excuse her. She’s been very naughty and I’ll have to give her a talking to about it. But we must make allowances for her. She’s never been taught what is right. And you were too hard on her, Rachel."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P28](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0028)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla became Anne's adoptive mother after the young orphan was mistakenly brought to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) instead of a boy. Though initially shocked and inclined to return her to the asylum, Marilla moved past her hesitation upon hearing about Anne's hard life and agreed to keep her. She took charge of raising [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by teaching her practical manners and religious duties, while slowly growing deeply attached to her despite Anne's vivid, distracting imagination.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P1](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P8](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER III. Marilla Cuthbert Is Surprised P39](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0039), +24 more_

### [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Marilla maintains a longstanding friendship with her neighbor Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) despite their strong differences in opinion. Marilla frequently confides in [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and seeks her advice on practical matters, such as handling Anne's behavioral issues. Their close relationship involves regular household visits and shared social outings, even though Rachel's blunt outspokenness occasionally creates friction within the family.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla acts as an authority figure to young [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md), keeping his rambunctious behavior in check by sending him to bed early and asserting control over his routine. Despite his frequent misbehavior and propensity for mischief—such as lying or hiding a toad in her bed—she finds herself growing fond of him while attempting to guide his upbringing.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P17](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0017), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P22](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0022), +14 more_
